da.name: StreakTennis
da.subtitle: Kampe, træning og AI-analyse
da.promotionalText: Registrér kampen bold for bold fra sidelinjen, få analysen bagefter — og hold din streak i live.
da.description:
StreakTennis er din tennis-app: kampe, træning og udvikling ét sted.

REGISTRÉR KAMPEN BOLD FOR BOLD
To tryk pr. point fra sidelinjen. Sæt, partier, serv, vindere og fejl — og kampens puls, så du kan se, hvor kampen vendte.

AI-ANALYSEN EFTER KAMPEN
Hvad virkede, hvad kostede point, og hvad skal trænes før næste kamp. Skrevet i et sprog, man kan tage med på banen.

HOLD DIN STREAK I LIVE
Hver træning tæller — tennis og fysisk. Log den på et øjeblik, og se ugen, måneden og sæsonen vokse.

BLIVER DU BEDRE?
Statistik på tværs af kampene: vundet og tabt, gratis fejl, vindere, første serv, breakbolde — kamp for kamp, hele sæsonen.

FØLG MED LIVE
Del kampen med dem, der ikke kan være der. De følger stillingen bold for bold — og at se med er altid gratis.

VENNER OG KLUB
Se, når dine venner spiller, saml holdet i et rum, og lad din klubs trænere følge din udvikling — når du selv siger ja.

SÆSONEN
Turneringerne, du kan tilmelde dig, samlet ét sted — med trænerens forslag øverst.

BASIS ER GRATIS
Streak, træning, kampe og venner — og 3 AI-analyser og 3 live-delte kampe. Fuld adgang er et månedligt abonnement, der kan opsiges når som helst: 40 AI-analyser om måneden og live-deling. Enkelte kampe kan også købes stykvis.

VI GEMMER TENNIS — ORD FORSVINDER
Kampe og resultater gemmes læsbart. Modstandernes navne og dine noter ligger kun i en boks, der er låst med dit kodeord. Beskeder forsvinder, når de er læst. Ingen annoncer, intet videresalg.

Privatlivspolitik: https://tennis.sportsainalytics.com/privatliv.html
Handelsbetingelser: https://tennis.sportsainalytics.com/handelsbetingelser.html

en-GB.name: StreakTennis
en-GB.subtitle: Matches, practice, AI insight
en-GB.promotionalText: Record the match point by point from the sideline, get the analysis afterwards — and keep your streak alive.
en-GB.description:
StreakTennis is your tennis app: matches, practice and development in one place.

RECORD THE MATCH POINT BY POINT
Two taps per point from the sideline. Sets, games, serve, winners and errors — and the pulse of the match, so you can see where it turned.

THE AI ANALYSIS AFTER THE MATCH
What worked, what cost points, and what to practise before the next match. Written in a language you can take onto the court.

KEEP YOUR STREAK ALIVE
Every session counts — tennis and fitness. Log it in a moment and watch the week, the month and the season grow.

ARE YOU GETTING BETTER?
Statistics across your matches: won and lost, unforced errors, winners, first serve, break points — match by match, all season.

FOLLOW LIVE
Share the match with those who cannot be there. They follow the score point by point — and watching is always free.

FRIENDS AND CLUB
See when your friends are playing, gather the team in a room, and let your club's coaches follow your development — when you say yes.

THE SEASON
The tournaments you can enter, gathered in one place — with your coach's suggestions on top.

BASIC IS FREE
Streak, practice, matches and friends — plus 3 AI analyses and 3 live-shared matches. Full access is a monthly subscription you can cancel at any time: 40 AI analyses a month and live sharing. Single matches can also be bought one at a time.

WE STORE TENNIS — WORDS DISAPPEAR
Matches and results are stored readable. Opponents' names and your notes live only in a box locked with your password. Messages disappear once they have been read. No ads, no resale.

Privacy policy: https://tennis.sportsainalytics.com/privatliv.html
Terms: https://tennis.sportsainalytics.com/handelsbetingelser.html

review.notes:
StreakTennis is a tennis app for players: match recording point by point, AI analysis after the match, training log and streak, statistics, live sharing, friends and club.

SIGN-IN: use the demo account above (Log ind → brugernavn + kodeord). The account holds fictional matches and training sessions, so every screen has content. All names in the demo data are fictional.

PURCHASES: subscriptions (Fuld adgang, Fuld adgang + fri streaming, Fri streaming) and consumables (matches, live matches) are Apple in-app purchases via StoreKit. No external payment method is offered in this build. Indstillinger → Din konto → Plan / Live-kampe. «Gendan køb» restores purchases.

ACCOUNT DELETION: Indstillinger → Din konto → Slet min konto (immediate, in-app).

USER CONTENT: friend chat and rooms are limited to 140 characters, with a word filter, report (⚑) and block (🚫). Messages are deleted one day after they have been read.

THE CLUB SIDE (coaches) is a separate web product, StreakCoach, and is not part of this app.

The app is built with Capacitor around our own web app, with native push notifications (APNs) and native in-app purchases.
